name: Needle
description: A 26M parameter function-calling (tool use) model distilled from Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite. Runs at 6000 tok/sec prefill and 1200 decode on consumer hardware. Designed for on-device AI tool calling on phones, watches, and other small devices. Beats larger models like FunctionGemma-270M and Qwen-0.6B on single-shot tool calling benchmarks.

name: LightningTrack
description: An issue tracker specifically built for AI-assisted development workflows. Features one-click AI prompt generation that turns any issue into context-rich prompts for Copilot, Cursor, or Claude. Includes an agent-friendly REST API that AI coding agents can talk to directly for live issue context. Simple pricing ($12/month per workspace) with no per-seat fees.

name: hermes-agentmemory
description: A pull-model episodic memory plugin for Hermes Agent that provides real deletes and an audit trace. Unlike other memory backends that consolidate in the background, this plugin does synchronous writes, immediate deletes, and logs all memory injections to a trace file for auditing. Designed for self-hosted agents where reversible growth is important.
